page.content:
Michael Bennett workshop musical about the gypsies on the line, a long Shubert tenant.

How A Chorus Line connects

  • Topic: Broadway — A Chorus Line is a defining 1970s Broadway musical.
  • Location: Shubert Theatre — A Chorus Line's original Broadway run was at the Shubert Theatre.
  • Work: Cats — Cats took Broadway's longest-run record from A Chorus Line.

What is A Chorus Line?

A Chorus Line is the 1975 musical built from dancers' taped stories, staged by Michael Bennett, that opened at the Shubert and held the longest-run record until Cats.

Key threads lead to Broadway, Shubert Theatre and Cats.
